steps.label: 3461-paper1094-reversed-pages-normal-modify
command: (()=>{if(location.pathname!=='/paper/detail.donga'||new URL(location.href).searchParams.get('paperId')!=='1094')throw Error('Own paper only');const a=[...document.querySelectorAll('a[href]')].filter(e=>{const u=new URL(e.href);return u.pathname==='/paper/modify.donga'&&u.searchParams.get('paperId')==='1094';});if(a.length!==1||a[0].matches('.disabled'))throw Error('Own paper Modify unavailable');a[0].click();return {clicked:true};})()
